If you can manage that, go south. After that, make an effort to go to the south. If you can get around to doing that, try to take a trip south. Once you succeed at that, go to the west. Then, attempt to head north. Okay, and then, travel west. Next, go west. Then, attempt to take a trip north. With that over with, go east. And then, head south. Once you accomplish that, try to take a trip south. And then, pick up the coin from the floor of the absurdly hot kitchen. And once you've done that, you win!
